privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: StarRank Explorer (starrank.dev, “the site”) respects your privacy. This policy explains what we collect, how it is used, and the choices available to you.

collect.p:
The site has no accounts and does not collect directly identifying information such as your name or email address.
We collect anonymous usage data only: pages visited, referring source, approximate region (country level), and device and browser type. It is used to measure traffic and improve the product, and cannot identify you personally.

cookies.p:
No analytics or advertising cookies are written until you press “Accept”.
Your choice is stored in your browser's local storage so you are not asked again on your next visit. If you decline, analytics either runs without cookies or does not load at all.

thirdParty.p:
The site uses the following third parties:
· Google Analytics (Google LLC) — traffic analytics
· DigitalOcean — hosting; the server keeps standard access logs
Each provider's own privacy policy governs the data it collects.

ads.p:
The site currently shows no advertising.
If Google AdSense is added later, third-party vendors may use cookies to serve ads based on your visits to this and other sites. This page will be updated at that point, and you can opt out of personalised advertising through Google's Ads Settings.

choices.p:
· Accept or decline analytics cookies via the banner at the bottom of the page
· Clearing your browser's local storage resets the choice and brings the banner back
· Block or delete cookies in your browser settings
· Use your browser's Do Not Track setting or a private window

contact.p: For questions about this policy, or about how data relating to you is handled, open an issue on the site's GitHub repository.

rank.bestIntro_productivity_notes: Open-source note apps keep your knowledge yours: local files, no lock-in, no subscription. This list is ranked by real data — star magnitude, recent momentum, and release activity — and refreshes daily, covering everything from Notion alternatives to Markdown-first editors.
rank.bestIntro_network_download: From video ripping to multi-threaded downloads, open-source download tools routinely beat their commercial rivals — no ads, no bundleware. Ranked daily by star magnitude, growth momentum, and maintenance activity, mixing CLI powerhouses like yt-dlp with GUI managers.
rank.bestIntro_system_screenshot: Screenshots and screen recording are everyday actions, and open source has you covered — annotation, scrolling capture, GIF recording and more. Ranked daily by stars, momentum, and release activity, from annotation tools to full recording suites.
rank.bestIntro_security_passwords: A password manager is the last software that should be closed source: you deserve to audit the code guarding your secrets. Ranked daily by stars, growth, and maintenance activity — spanning self-hostable Bitwarden-style vaults and local-first KeePass descendants.
rank.bestIntro_ai_local_llm: Running LLMs locally means privacy, zero API bills, and offline capability. Ranked daily by stars, momentum, and release activity — from one-command runners like Ollama to GGUF inference engines that bring AI back onto your own machine.

mcp.title: StarRank MCP server
mcp.metaDescription: Query StarRank's open-source rankings from Claude Code, Cursor and other AI coding agents with a free, read-only MCP server.
mcp.intro: Ask your coding agent about open-source projects and get StarRank's rankings back: what is trending today, the top projects of a domain or language, or how one repository ranks. Read-only, free, no API key.
mcp.otherClients: Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf and other clients: add a remote (HTTP) MCP server with this URL.

tools.search_repos: Search repositories by keyword, most relevant first.
tools.top_repos: A ranking, optionally within a domain and/or language, by total stars or by stars gained per day, week or month.
tools.trending_today: The repositories that gained the most stars in the last day.
tools.get_repo: One repository: stars, growth, and its overall, language and domain ranks with the change since the previous day.
tools.list_domains: The domain taxonomy with repository counts.

mcp.examples:
Which Rust projects gained the most stars this week?
What is trending in AI agents today?
How does ollama/ollama rank, and is it moving up?
mcp.limits: Every result links to its page on starrank.dev. Up to 25 rows per call; calls are rate-limited per client. Data refreshes once a day.

verdict.label: 추천
verdict.ruleDomain: 순위 기준: GitHub 스타 총수 내림차순. 추천은 상위 {pool}개 중 {fresh}일 안에 커밋이 있고 목록·튜토리얼이 아닌, 스타가 가장 많은 프로젝트이며, 근거는 스타·성장·커밋·릴리스·순위만 인용해 모두 GitHub에서 확인할 수 있습니다. 매일 갱신, 마지막 갱신 {date}.
verdict.ruleShelf: 순위 기준: 이 선반의 스타 상위 60개 앱을 ln(스타) + 2×ln(일간 증가) + 90일 내 릴리스 2점 + 설치 파일 1점으로 정렬해 상위 {count}개를 표시. 추천은 이 점수를 쓰지 않고, 이 페이지에서 {fresh}일 안에 커밋이 있고 설치 파일이 있는 스타 최다 앱입니다. 매일 갱신, 마지막 갱신 {date}.

board.title: 스타가 많은 GitHub 저장소
board.rulesCommon: “오늘”은 가장 최근 수집값에서 전날 값을 뺀 것이고, “7일”은 가장 최근 수집값에서 7일 전 값을 뺀 것입니다. 순위 변동은 어제의 스타 총수 순위와 비교하며, 같으면 표시하지 않습니다. 막대는 일별 신규 스타이고 맨 오른쪽이 가장 최근 날짜입니다. 매일 UTC 03:30에 수집합니다.

repoPage.judgeSub: 네 가지 질문, 모두 GitHub에서 확인 가능
repoPage.license_permissive: 허용적 라이선스; 상업적 사용은 대체로 문제없음
repoPage.license_copyleft: 카피레프트: 수정본을 배포하려면 같은 라이선스를 써야 함
repoPage.license_other: 일반적인 오픈소스 라이선스가 아님; 사용 전에 원문 확인
repoPage.license_none: 라이선스 미표기, 따라서 모든 권리가 보유됨
repoPage.dataNote: 스타, fork, issue, 릴리스는 GitHub 공개 API에서 가져옵니다. 일별 증가는 연속한 두 수집값의 차이이며, 격일로 수집하는 저장소는 그 사이 날짜에 균등하게 나눕니다. StarRank는 종합 점수를 매기지 않고, 직접 확인할 수 있는 원시 신호만 보여줍니다.
